course_description: This course deals with the fundamentals machine learning techniques, as well as hands-on experience applying these techniques and developing new techniques for solving problems from the real world; topics include regression (least square regression, lasso), classification (naive Bayes, nearest support vector machines, logistic regression), kernel methods, unsupervised methods (k-means clustering, dimensionality reduction), stochastic optimization, deep learning and recent advances in big data analytics. Student can attend seminars, workshops, and training in relevant disciplines onsite or online.
